answer_1.quote: We evaluate our editing method HPR on eliciting truthfulness from LLMs. Experiment results on the TruthfulQA dataset demonstrate a significant boost in performance ... we also demonstrate the proposed method on other behavior-related problems, including bias, ethics, and toxicity, using the BBQ, SEQ, and Toxigen datasets.
